_comment: The 'this or that' refinement stage. Each axis is a spectrum with two poles. A user's position on each axis is learned from forced-choice pairs and becomes a multiplier on articles that show that axis's signal phrases. Signals are matched against title+abstract+publication type. Questions are specialty-agnostic; {topic} is substituted with one of the user's chosen subtopics so the choice feels concrete.
